```{r}
library(tidyverse)

source("tapho_loader_new.R")
source("post_loader_metadata_pipeline.R")

excel_path <- "hspa.xlsx"

lvl <- c(2,1,1,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2)

tapho_db <- tapho.loader(
  excel_path, sum = FALSE, 
  level = lvl
)
```


```{r}
source("post_loader_metadata_pipeline.R")

analysis <- run_post_loader_metadata_pipeline(
  tapho_db,
  output_root = "post_loader_analysis",
  min_group_n = 2
)

tapho_clean <- analysis$data

```
